about: Numbers measured while building Pehra, before the owner's recordings and the AWS run. Each names what it measured, on what machine, where it was reported, and the date. The dev box is watchful-dev on our ioflood server: a 2013 Intel Xeon E5-2680 v2 without AVX2, 6 CPUs of a shared 40 core host, stock OpenCV 5.0.0 on x86. None of these numbers is from AWS or COOL. docs/fill.py reads this file; never copy its numbers by hand.

pool_steady_mb_run1.what: total memory, steady median, of the shared camera pool: 8 Plaza demo cameras on 2 camera processes for 75 s, in a container shaped like c8g.large (2 pinned CPUs, 4 GB); indexing off, no watch described in words, a stand in AI, so not the app's defaults

old_steady_mb_run1.what: the same scenario on the earlier design, one process per camera (pehra 9bf0ad0), steady median

pool_peak_mb.what: the shared pool's higher peak of its two runs

old_peak_mb.what: one process per camera, the higher peak of its two runs

single_ms.what: YOLOX nano, one frame at a time on one thread, per frame, dev box

batch4_ms.what: the same network fed a batch of 4 frames, per frame; dropped because the stock YOLOX export returned different boxes for a batch (no row of a batch of 2 matched a single run)

image_opencv_mb.what: memory the SigLIP 2 B/32 image tower adds to a process on OpenCV DNN, one thread, dev box

image_ort_mb.what: the same tower on ONNX Runtime with its memory arena and weight prepacking off

text_opencv_mb.what: memory the SigLIP 2 text tower adds on OpenCV DNN

text_ort_mb.what: the same tower on ONNX Runtime, arena and prepacking off

cosine.what: cosine between the OpenCV DNN and ONNX Runtime vectors of the same image and the same text

before_mb.what: total memory, 8 Plaza cameras on 2 processes with app defaults and a watch in words on every camera, first start, before the change (ce710da): over the 3,072 MB budget

after_mb.what: the same after the change, once the text tower was dropped (steady state), inside the budget; container with 2 CPUs, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2

no_text_before_mb.what: the same 8 cameras without a watch in words, before the change

no_text_after_mb.what: the same 8 cameras without a watch in words, after the change

fps.what: analysed frames a second per camera with a watch in words on 8 busy Plaza cameras on 2 CPUs, before and after the change: CPU, not memory, limits it (every tracked person is embedded every few seconds)

yunet_js_320_ms.what: YuNet face detection in OpenCV.js 5.0 (single thread WebAssembly, Node on the ioflood CPU) on a 320x200 picture, the size the device page uses

qr_classic_missed.what: valid random device link QR codes (of 300) that cv2.QRCodeDetector failed to read

qr_aruco_read.what: the same 300 codes read by cv2.QRCodeDetectorAruco

crop_ms.what: one vehicle crop through the plate box path (LPD-YuNet, warp, PP-OCRv5), dev box while quiet

lpd_ms.what: LPD-YuNet plate detection at 640 px, dev box

ocr_line_ms.what: PP-OCRv5 recognition of one plate line, dev box

fuzzed.what: fuzzed plates with the last character cut off, scored by the real confidence functions

fuzzed_max_conf.what: the highest confidence any wrong read of those cut plates reached (a plate text is kept only from 0.52, Tuning plates.min_conf)

gate_runs.what: synthetic gate runs with real YOLOX, tracker, line, plate reader and gate log (a real car photo moved over a drawn gate, a person standing on the line) at 1 and 2 analysed frames a second, detector every frame and every second frame

gate_runs_paired.what: of those runs, the ones that logged one in and one out, paired by plate

gate_conf_min.what: the lowest plate confidence in those runs

gate_conf_max.what: the highest plate confidence in those runs

still_body_max.what: own movement of a still body in moving water, body heights a second, after comparing the flow in the box with the ring around it (DIS optical flow, rendered water at 2 to 10 px a second)

swimmer_min.what: the same measure for swimmers, lowest

swimmer_max.what: the same measure for swimmers, highest

dis_look_ms.what: one DIS optical flow look (MEDIUM preset, 160 px crops), dev box

gate_same_day.what: zone state by example: score of a closed gate against its own saved example by day (blur, CLAHE, Sobel edge picture)

gate_other_day.what: the same against the open gate's example by day

gate_same_night.what: closed gate against its own example at night

gate_other_night.what: closed gate against the open example at night

gate_same_no_blur.what: closed gate against its own example without the blur before CLAHE (CLAHE lifted sensor noise into the edges)

requests.what: plain words requests compiled with the real AI (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on OpenRouter), from the pool, gates, lobby, generator smoke, a ladder and a covered camera
requests.source: task-5-report.md, Real LLM run after the fixes

generic.what: of those, compiled into the generic building blocks with no new code (the request about a child became a watch on someone alone plus a plain refusal of the age part)
generic.source: task-5-report.md, Real LLM run after the fixes

fastest_s.source: task-5-report.md, Real LLM run after the fixes

slowest_s.source: task-5-report.md, Real LLM run after the fixes

must_refuse.what: look texts about children, in many spellings and scripts, that must be refused

meaning_refused.what: of those, refused by the SigLIP 2 meaning check alone (the words and age patterns refuse the rest)

must_pass.what: ordinary look texts that must pass

must_pass_refused.what: of those, refused by the meaning check

held_out.what: held out child texts not used to pick the anchors or the margin

held_out_refused.what: of those, refused by the meaning check alone; the 6 it missed are numbers, heights or 'a juvenile', and the word patterns catch 5 of them

walk_s.what: the browser test from the landing page's Try the demo to an acknowledged incident with its Telegram message, real AI, against the server on the dev box (after the demo's fix round)

idle_10_mb.what: app and camera processes with 10 demo sandboxes open and nobody watching, 2 camera processes, dev box

watched_10_mb.what: the same with all 10 sandboxes' Plaza cameras watched at once

watched_10_fps_min.what: analysed frames a second per camera while all 10 were watched, lowest

aws_month_usd.what: an estimate, not a bill: one c8g.xlarge in Mumbai all month at on demand list price, COOL's fee, a 40 GB gp3 volume, a public IPv4 address, CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboard and logs; before Bedrock, S3 and data transfer
aws_month_usd.source: task-12-report.md, fix round 1, budget table (AWS price data published 2026-10-23)

lighthouse_mobile_performance.what: Lighthouse 12.8.2 mobile performance score of the landing page (vite preview of the built site, dev box)

lighthouse_mobile_accessibility.what: Lighthouse mobile accessibility score of the landing page
